summary: Full E2E testing of Safar Travel CRM Phase 1 (auth, RBAC, user management, audit, role-permissions, HPP). Backend: 23/23 pytest tests passed. Frontend: all 3 role flows working - Super Admin sees all menus and can CRUD users, save role perms, view audit; Sales restricted to 7 sales menus and gets Forbidden page on /users /audit /hpp /settings; Accounting sees accounting menus incl. HPP table, /users returns Forbidden. Change-password menu item exists in user dropdown. Reset-password page loads with form. Forgot-password endpoint returns success.

issues: Console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for DialogContent (accessibility) - non-blocking, best practice to add DialogDescription for a11y

action_items: Optional: Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to DialogContent components (Add User dialog etc.) to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend RBAC is correctly enforced at API level via require_permission/require_role dependencies (verified: Sales gets 403 on /hpp /users /audit-logs /role-permissions; Accounting gets 200 on /hpp but 403 on /users and /role-permissions).
Frontend guards correctly render <Forbidden/> page (data-testid=forbidden-page) for restricted routes per role.
Menus in nav.js correctly filtered per role - no leakage of restricted items to Sales/Accounting.

Note: Super Admin sidebar does not include a top-level nav-hpp entry (HPP is grouped under Accounting menu). Not a bug - Super Admin can still access /api/hpp and /hpp route. If a direct HPP entry is desired for Super Admin, add it to nav.js SUPER_ADMIN menu list.
